scope: Five exact raw generated bodies labeled R1-R5 in the supplied packet. Only that packet was used for content decisions. No automatic-result, label-mapping, reader-review, cost, model, or prior-pilot-verdict artifact was read. No model request, database access, network access, or runtime edit was performed.

method.sourcePass: Requires zero unsupported claims, preserved source conditions, complete citation parent closure, faithful selected meanings, correct stated geometry and chronology, and no substantive unresolved source issue.

contextIntegrationScale.2: Some source context present but materially distorted or poorly integrated
contextIntegrationScale.3: Context joined to the scene but a selected meaning is missing or distorted
contextIntegrationScale.4: All selected meanings faithfully joined early, with only minor integration limitations
contextIntegrationScale.5: All selected meanings faithfully and clearly embodied in a shared early scene; single-source cases receive a coverage score but are marked not applicable to multi-context integration

method.concreteMaterial: Reviewed scenes and optional directions are valid illustrations. They do not authorize an unsourced causal, ease, speed, frequency, necessity, personality, or historical claim.
method.qualifiers: A modal must qualify a source-supported proposition. Can, may, or if cannot make a new proposition grounded. Clear immediate references may continue the same hypothetical.

findings.span: practical initiative can make another piece of the same project start to look appealing to take up
findings.reason: I2 supplies mutual reinforcement between enthusiasm and practical initiative under a well-chosen aim, and low-friction effort that makes taking up a larger piece natural. The reviewed material permits an appealing next piece as a scene. It does not establish the narrower directional claim that practical initiative creates the appeal of another piece. 'Can' preserves possibility but cannot supply this causal relationship. The rendering also drops the source's explicit reciprocal reinforcement.
findings.minimumCorrection: Keep the well-chosen-aim condition and express enthusiasm and practical initiative coming together, then use the appealing piece as an illustrative detail without making initiative its cause.

findings.span: Moving a familiar task to a later calendar opening without changing what it includes may leave an extra check attached.
findings.reason: The full body never conveys that an established responsibility can require more deliberate effort, nor that a possible expectations/capacity mismatch is the reason its boundary may need to become clearer. Moving the same contents and changing a stopping point are reviewed applications, but here they replace the selected I1 meaning. P2's earlier-method condition is preserved; it does not substitute for I1's demand/capacity relationship.
findings.minimumCorrection: Integrate the possible effort demand and the conditional capacity/boundary relationship into the shared task scene without assuming the reader has that mismatch.

findings.reason: The sources and reviewed scene permit an extra check or version being added. They do not say adding it occurs easily. The local modal 'can' does not ground the added ease.
The reviewed direction permits leaving the extra check out if the original work fills the afternoon. 'Simply' adds an unsupported suggestion of ease or uncomplicated removal.

findings.span: keeping a page of notes for one idea beside a tab open for another can blur where your attention belongs
findings.reason: The notes/tab image is explicitly reviewed material, so its concreteness is legitimate. N1 says multiple lines of curiosity can help a direction take shape and that sampling and choosing may be separate stages. Neither N1 nor the reviewed image says keeping notes beside a tab blurs the reader's proper allocation of attention. The sentence invents a causal attention problem and shifts the lens from possible exploration toward confusion. The preceding 'If several projects...' condition does not authorize this new effect.
findings.minimumCorrection: Retain the conditional notes/tab image and the exploration-versus-commitment distinction; remove the invented attention-blurring consequence.

N1's direction-forming possibility is also displaced by the invented attention problem identified in R3-F3.
findings.minimumCorrection: Restore the possible deliberate-effort meaning and express N1 as exploratory possibility without the added confusion claim.
